method: Same release binary; four validators and one client on shared 8-logical-CPU AArch64 macOS; real Ed25519; durable sync-before-vote; 20 ms fixed one-way delay; 5-second offered-load windows; 5-second deadline; max-inflight 16384; diagnostics disabled. First sweep then repeated 2500 TPS controls/candidates; not randomized. Throughput includes drain. Every run audited by fresh-process journal recovery before deleting private fixtures.

r2200-b128-w1-t1.measurement_definition: Signed transaction submission before transport enqueue to client receipt and effects QC verification from strict Ed25519-verified immutable votes and quorum/domain/key-binding checks; client generation/signing excluded; network queues, fixed per-direction delay, validator validation/signing and group sync_all before votes included.
r2200-b128-w1-t1.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; bounded journal group commit; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.
